% A test for tex8web: algorithm2e's algorithms, ruled, with vertical lines
% along their blocks and numbered lines. The caption is at the left
% between two rules, at the top wherever \caption is, and a rule ends the
% body, all three as wide as the text, as in the PDF, also in an [H]
% algorithm. Each line is a line of its own, its number in the margin and
% its keywords bold; a block's line ends in a short rule unless an else
% follows. A \ref to an algorithm and to one of its lines leads there.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsmath}
\usepackage[ruled,vlined,linesnumbered]{algorithm2e}
\begin{document}
\section{Search}
Algorithm~\ref{alg:search} finds the smallest $i$ with $a_i \ge x$; its
loop ends at line~\ref{line:return}.
\begin{algorithm}
\caption{Binary search}\label{alg:search}
\KwIn{a sorted array $a_1 \le \dots \le a_n$ and a value $x$}
\KwOut{the least $i$ with $a_i \ge x$, or $n+1$}
$\ell \gets 1$, $h \gets n + 1$\tcp*{the answer is in $[\ell, h]$}
\While{$\ell < h$}{
  $m \gets \lfloor (\ell + h)/2 \rfloor$\;
  \eIf{$a_m < x$}{
    $\ell \gets m + 1$\tcp*{$a_1, \dots, a_m < x$}
  }{
    $h \gets m$\;
  }
}
\Return{$\ell$}\label{line:return}\;
\For{$k = 1, \dots, K$}{
  $s_k \gets \sum_{j=1}^{k} a_j$\;
}
\end{algorithm}
Text after the algorithm.

\begin{algorithm}[H]
\DontPrintSemicolon
\KwData{a graph $G = (V, E)$}
\ForEach{$v \in V$}{
  \tcc{a comment on its own line}
  \uIf{$\deg v = 0$}{remove $v$}
  \ElseIf{$\deg v = 1$}{mark $v$}
  \Else{keep $v$}
}
\Repeat{no vertex is marked}{
  remove the marked vertices\label{line:remove}
}
\caption{An \texttt{[H]} algorithm, its caption at the end}\label{alg:prune}
\end{algorithm}
See Algorithm~\ref{alg:prune}, line~\ref{line:remove}.
